hook: SQL mein [[loop]]? Haan bhai, ho sakta hai

slides.title: Recursive = [[khud ko call]]
points: CTE jo **apne hi naam** ko andar use kare
Har round mein **nayi rows** banti hain
Nayi row na bane to **ruk jaata** hai
slides.note: Jaise do mirror aamne-saamne: image ke andar image 🪞

slides.title: 1 se 5 [[ginti]]
slides.code:
WITH RECURSIVE nums AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1 FROM nums
  WHERE n < 5
)
SELECT n FROM nums;
slides.note: SQL Server mein **RECURSIVE** keyword nahi, sirf **WITH**

slides.title: Round by [[round]]
slides.note: n = 5 pe WHERE fail → nayi row nahi → **loop khatam** 🛑

slides.title: Asli use: [[org chart]]
slides.code:
WITH RECURSIVE t AS (
  SELECT id, name, 1 AS lvl
  FROM emp WHERE boss_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, lvl+1
  FROM emp e JOIN t
    ON e.boss_id = t.id
) SELECT * FROM t;
slides.note: CEO se shuru, har level pe **neeche ke log**. Data khatam = stop

slides.wrong:
SELECT n + 1 FROM nums
-- WHERE gayab
slides.right:
SELECT n + 1 FROM nums
WHERE n < 5
slides.why: Stop nahi to **infinite loop** → error (SQL Server: 100, MySQL: 1000 recursion limit) 💀
